title: Reusable Garden Bag with Handles – Heavy-Duty for Leaves & Grass
descriptionHtml:
Thin trash bags that burst under leaves and branches?

Ordinary plastic bags tear in the middle of raking, tip over and can't be reused. You're left standing there with leaves all over the lawn and a torn bag in your hand.

A bag that lasts – year after year

The heavy-duty garden bag stands upright on its own with sturdy handles, swallows leaves, grass and branches without bursting, and folds flat for storage. Reuse it the whole garden season.

Features

  • Heavy-duty, tear-resistant material – doesn't split like plastic bags.
  • Sturdy handles – easy to carry and empty.
  • Stands upright – fill it with both hands.
  • Several sizes – 60, 120 and 300 liters.
  • Foldable – takes up no space in storage.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
